title: Solar camera aimed at the portal spot on fenced-off ranch

tellings.quote: pointing exactly at the point where Linda Bradshaw says she saw the portal.

plain: On Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, a fenced-off property, a camera powered by solar panels is aimed at one exact spot: the place where Linda Bradshaw, who lived on the ranch, says she saw a portal, a doorway into somewhere else. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels he saw the camera himself in 2025, pointing "exactly at the point where Linda Bradshaw says she saw the portal." He takes it to mean that someone is still watching the spot closely.
